item.title: docs: legacy reference moves to legacy/duo-inner-cover @ 2fe43da3
item.body:
Refs #655
Claim: mac/m2-lead

**Problem.** Contributors are told to cite legacy at `2440d79`, which predates behaviour the published app has: the composer's formatting bar (#653) and the floating "+" button (#654) exist only after it, so parity checks at `2440d79` called them new.

**Cause.** The reference was pinned when the audit started and never moved; the published iPhone Duo beta is `legacy/duo-inner-cover` @ `2fe43da3` (PR #372, based on `master` `21173e77`).

**Change.** Per the operator decision on #655 (2026-11-08), every place that prescribes the citation target now names `2fe43da3`, and says how to read it (`git fetch origin legacy/duo-inner-cover`, `git show 2fe43da3:<path>`):
- `AGENTS.md` §2 (reference + how to read it), §4 (legacy pointer format), §11 (dated learning);
- `docs/lots/TEMPLATE.md` (Legacy sources, Legacy counterpart);
- `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` header (source citation rule for new entries);
- `docs/agents/EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md` §2 (was `git show origin/master:<path>`).

No existing citation is rewritten: `2440d79` citations stay valid for what they cite. `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`, the GAP table and their fragment folders are untouched (#620). The legacy-oracle tooling stays on its `2440d79` patch (an oracle concern, not a citation rule).

Remaining for #655: the sweep of `2440d79..2fe43da3` (posted on #655 separately).

**Tests.** Docs only: `check-lot-deps.py`, `fold.py --check` and pre-commit pass locally; markdownlint runs in CI.

comments.body:
Adversarial review (Fable 5.1) of `9dbdcca9945fda1a17dda7731c93d2baf80e08ef`: **APPROVE**

Scope checked: `gh pr diff 660`, `git grep -n 2440d79 pr-660` (every hit classified), issue #655 (decision + sweep), `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agents/*`, `docs/lots/TEMPLATE.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.github/`, `tooling/*/README.md`.

**Verified**
- `2fe43da3` is an ancestor of `origin/legacy/duo-inner-cover` and of PR #372's head; `git merge-base origin/master 2fe43da3` = `21173e77` = `origin/master` tip, so "based on `master` `21173e77`" is exact; `2440d79` is an ancestor of both (`master` and `2fe43da3`), so "stay valid for what they cite" is correct.
- Every prescription moved: AGENTS.md §2, §4 (pointer format, with the "existing `@ 2440d79` pointers stay" clause), `docs/lots/TEMPLATE.md` (both sections, no `2440d79` left), `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` header, `docs/agents/EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md` §2 (`upstream` is defined in its §3, as the text says). `ORCHESTRATION`, `REVIEW-ROUNDS`, `LESSONS`, `MAC-SESSIONS`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.github/` carry no `2440d79` or `git show origin/master` prescription.
- No historical citation rewritten: the remaining hits are lot specs, features, GAP table, changelog, oracle JSON, app `// Port of … @ 2440d79` comments, `docs/audit/README.md` (the audit's revision), `CREDITS.md`, ADR 0013/0014, `tooling/legacy-oracle` (explicitly deferred to #673, named in §2).
- §11 keeps the 2026-11-07 #620 line and adds the 2026-11-08 #655 line. Links #655, #673, the GAP anchor and TEMPLATE resolve. CI green (Pre-commit, Docs consistency).

**Findings (none blocking)**

1. Low — `docs/changelog-legacy.d/README.md:9`, `:13` and `tooling/docs/README.md:20`. The ledger instructions a feature PR follows still show `@ \`2440d79\`` as the example row and describe the proof cell as "file:line on `master` or a capture". Scenario: a contributor writing a `### Ledger` block copies the example and cites `master` or `2440d79` for behaviour that only exists at `2fe43da3`. Fix: in the cell description say "legacy `file:line` at the reference of AGENTS.md §2 (`2fe43da3`; older rows at `2440d79` stay) or a capture"; the example row may stay (LOT-031's citation was at `2440d79`). Can go in this PR or in the steward's next ledger PR.

2. Low (process) — PR body `Claim: mac/m2-lead`, but #655 has no `/claim` comment and is `status: needs-triage` (not `status: claimed`). AGENTS §8: the `Claim:` line equals the issue's active claim, reviewers check it until `pr-issue.yml` runs from `master`. Fix: post `/claim mac/m2-lead` on #655 and set `status: claimed` before merging.

3. Info — `origin/legacy/duo-inner-cover` moved this morning (2026-11-09 06:38, now `ea531a2a`, three Duo UI commits after `2fe43da3`). The text only pins the hash and never calls it the tip, so nothing is false; "the version of the published iPhone Duo beta" is the operator's statement on #655. If the published build is rebuilt from the new tip, re-pin in the same four places (§2, §4, TEMPLATE, HFR-PROTOCOL header) and on the `(or #372's merge commit once it lands)` clause.

4. Info — `docs/migration/GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md:5` ("Legacy = `master` at `2440d79`") and the open convergence note `:276` ("Oracle revision … pick one revision") are now answered by #655; left for the steward per #620, as the PR says. Worth a line in the sweep's follow-ups so it is not lost (the sweep lists GAP-058/102/034 but not the header and note 1).

5. Nit — AGENTS.md:62 "Behaviour added after `2440d79` exists only there": most of it also exists on `master` (`2440d79..21173e77`), which the reference contains. "exists there, not at `2440d79`" would be exact. Optional.

Fable APPROVE on 9dbdcca9 (comment 6733978597). Findings: 1 (ledger README example rows) belongs to the ledger steward per #620, recorded on #655; 2 fixed (#655 claimed, label set); 3 and 4 noted on #655; 5 nit, not taken. Merging.
